title: Selective Keep Inventory
description: Lightweight mod that allows operators to configure specific items that will be kept on death
body:
Lightweight mod that allows operators to configure a list of items and tags that will be kept on death, the rest drops.

Experience points are also able to be kept on death, with a configurable %.

All commands fall under /selectiveKeepInventory

The game rule keep inventory must be off for the mod to be enabled.
